verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs cover defining roles and permissions: they reference role-based authorization, and an Authorization Services guide documents resources, role-based, JavaScript, time-based and regex policies. Enforcement is via UMA permission tickets and the Protection API, and roles can also be administered through kcadm and the Admin REST API. Token introspection is available for authorization checks, but no excerpt states that roles or permissions are embedded as claims in issued access/ID tokens. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of role/permission claims in session tokens, hands-on or independent corroboration of RBAC enforcement.
